## What's changed

Jarvis finally gets a face — a logo and full favicon set, plus a dependency fix that closed two high-severity advisories.

### Added
- **Logo & favicons** — a proper logo (embedded in the README) and a full favicon set (favicon.ico, 16x16/32x32 PNG, apple-touch-icon) wired into the browser tab and bookmarks
- **NOTICE** — the logo/favicon assets are now explicitly excluded from the Apache-2.0 grant (all rights reserved), separate from the project's open-source code license

### Security
- **browserslist** patched to ≥4.28.7 via a pnpm override, closing two high-severity advisories (unbounded memory growth / OOM, and an uncaught crash via untrusted browserslist-stats.json) pulled in transitively through `eslint-plugin-react-hooks`

**Full diff:** [v1.9.3...v1.10.0](https://github.com/kj187/jarvis/compare/v1.9.3...v1.10.0)
